units: metres; engine +Y up, +Z visitor/front; origin at ground centre
ownership: Existing hub/ecoenergy/aquabio/ecocycle ModuleSession owns descriptors; shared/models/ canonical GLBs remain immutable. No new installation or public SDK surface.
material_policy: Opaque flat-shaded metal, ceramic, wood, earth and geometric unlit lettering; no textures, downloads, new shaders or per-instance material overrides.
instance_policy: 12 additional static, noninteractive instances; previous 240 descriptors, 20 interactions and 24 animations retained unchanged.

models.name: Reloj solar ecuatorial
models.design: Inclined open equatorial ring, axial gnomon, engraved hour markers and tripod; no recoloured solar panel.
models.purpose: Relacionar orientacion, sombra y tiempo solar; escala ilustrativa, sin hora geografica calibrada ni sombras solares calculadas.

models.name: Disco Secchi en soporte
models.design: Four-quadrant circular visibility disk suspended from an open reel gantry; distinct from flow gauges, sampling furniture and waste bins.
models.purpose: Interpretar transparencia del agua mediante disco; no medir turbidez ni certificar potabilidad. Relaciona tratamiento y agua de lavado.

models.name: Pluviometro de balancin seccionado
models.design: Open cutaway collector funnel, twin tipping buckets, pivot and reference scale on a narrow mast; no copy of roof/cistern or anemometer.
models.purpose: Distinguir precipitacion de volumen almacenado; mecanismo estatico ilustrativo, sin datos meteorologicos ni animacion nueva.

models.name: Perfil edafico didactico
models.design: Vertical irregular soil horizons, branching root tubes and visible aggregate pockets in a freestanding section; not a planter or treatment filter.
models.purpose: Relacionar horizontes, raices y materia organica con retencion de agua y compostaje; no simular infiltracion.

models.name: Balanza de masas de materiales
models.design: Central knife-edge beam with two suspended pans, pointer and unequal-volume sample shapes; no copy of a workbench or battery indicator.
models.purpose: Distinguir masa, volumen y seleccion de materiales en energia y circularidad; muestra estatica sin pesaje ni metrologia certificada.

spatial_requirements: Keep existing ground sizes, cameras, portal volumes and original descriptors. Validate imported metric bounds, main/secondary paths and front observation rays; adjust only new placements if a conservative AABB check finds a conflict, recording the reason.
validation: 105 original GLB hashes and 240 original CSV rows unchanged; five normalized geometry signatures distinct from all original resources; 12 shared instances/4 owners, pointer identity, lifecycle, rollback, reentry, original 30 CTests plus shared tests; CPU/GL-simulated sanitizers and real OpenGL navigation/captures/performance reported separately.
storage_strategy: Reuse linux-dev for all normal/GPU work. Existing sanitizer trees contain protected or historical evidence; one writable build/sanitized is justified if no compatible nonhistorical tree exists. GPU outputs are not builds; no cleanup, no raw-protected-file copies. Alert if growth exceeds 2147483648 bytes.
